pharmacology.text: LEK-8842, also known as N-methyl-N-(2-propynyl)lysergamide or as TRALA-01, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the lysergamide family related to the psychedelic drug LSD. The drug is described as showing serotonin 5-HT2 receptor partial agonistic activity and α-adrenergic receptor agonistic activity based on in-vitro tissue assays that included selective antagonist challenges.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: It was developed by the Slovenian pharmaceutical company LEK Pharmaceuticals.
